note: Descriptive statistics from the embeddings; not reported paper results.

protocol.cv: the paper's 5 family-grouped folds (grouped_all_k5_s0); encoders, 2PL and probes refitted per fold

rule.text: A property is included only if at least 40 of the 260 models carry a label, its family-grouped out-of-fold R² is at least 0.50 (AUROC at least 0.85 for a binary label), and it beats the best baseline by at least 0.05 with the lower end of a paired bootstrap 95% interval above zero. The baselines are the label mean and a metadata-only ridge on the other metadata (size, release date, base vs chat). Style traits must also beat a bits-only ridge on the BULLPEN-bits+q embedding, because a style trait read from the answers should add to what correctness already carries.
